receipt.name: WarmJpeg
receipt.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
receipt.recipe: HorizontalFlipInput.Create(16): original 513x259 asymmetric RGBA16, phase zero, alpha zero at both first-row ends, hidden RGB unchanged. JPEG source alpha is flattened once onto RGB 0x204060; target is opaque 8-bit 4:2:0. No extra source raster. Full 16-bit alpha flattening and normalization to 8-bit use one rounding after blending, inside every operation. Fresh forward-only Stream wrapper over fresh owned MemoryStream storage; fixed geometric AC Huffman path.
receipt.qualityPolicy: fixed-anchor-v1: native qscale 5 / managed quality 69 / RGBA16 to 4:2:0; one owned evaluation; no quality sweep
receipt.outputBoundary: Fresh forward-only Stream wrapper over fresh owned MemoryStream storage; wrapper creation/disposal and storage growth included; no seek/length/position access.
